cves.description: Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.

cves.name: OSGeo GeoServer XML Injection Vulnerability
cves.description: OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.

blocks.text: The leading newly prioritized issue is **CVE-2026-136716 (Drupal Core)**, a critical security flaw; it is listed in CISA KEV on 2026-11-27 (exploitation confirmed by CISA) and reported exploited by ENISA EUVD since 2026-11-27. **CVE-2026-136716 - Drupal Core Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability (CVSS 9.8).** Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.23, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.23, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.14. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-123903 - VMware Directory Service authentication bypass (CVSS 9.8).** VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service. Broadcom has evaluated the severity of this issue to be in the Critical severity range with a maximum CVSSv3 base score of 9.8. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

EPSS: 2.4% probability / 85th percentile (FIRST EPSS). CISA KEV: Not listed in latest verified baseline. Exploitation: No malicious exploitation confirmed by tracked sources. Public exploit code referenced: 2 unvetted GitHub repositories; weaponized exploit not verified. Mitigation: Apply the vendor fix or mitigation; remove untrusted network reachability until patched; place the service behind authentication or a VPN; monitor for exploitation.

**CVE-2026-137043 - TOTOLINK N350RT authorization bypass (CVSS 9.3).** A security vulnerability has been detected in TOTOLINK N350RT 9.3.5u.6468_B20250827/9.3.5u.6466_B20250825. The affected element is the function setLanguageCfg of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument lang leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-133336 - CVE-2026-133336 unrestricted file upload (CVSS 9.5).** Joomla Extension - chronoengine.com - Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in ChronoForms extension 8.0.0-8.0.53 - When the Filename Provider option of a file field is used, the file extension check is performed against the original client filename instead of the final stored filename, allowing unauthenticated users to upload files with dangerous extensions. Fixed in 8.0.54. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. CVE-2026-136716 (Drupal Core): listed in CISA KEV on 2026-11-27 (exploitation confirmed by CISA) and reported exploited by ENISA EUVD since 2026-11-27. No named actor, verified victim count or campaign is established in tracked sources. No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds.

CISA added 3 vulnerabilities to the KEV catalog in the reporting window: Drupal Core, OSGeo GeoServer and OSGeo GeoServer. The federal remediation deadline is **November 30, 2026**. This deadline applies to covered federal agencies under applicable requirements; it is not a universal private-sector mandate.

**Defensive hunting:** for Drupal Core (CVE-2026-136716), review the affected service's logs for unusual requests and changes around the disclosure date; for OSGeo GeoServer (CVE-2026-120705), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for OSGeo GeoServer (CVE-2026-129243), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for VMware Directory Service (CVE-2026-123903), review administrative logins, newly created accounts or API tokens, and configuration changes made without a matching change record.
